cam1.headingNote: Pads 2.0 m apart, straight; Black faces pad-02 at takeoff (forward = toward target).
cam1.summary: Black: pad-01 (home) → pad-02 (2.0 m) → Grok describe → wait for voice command
cam1.describeQuestion: Briefly describe the scene from this indoor drone: people (clothes, colours), notable objects, and left/centre/right. Two short sentences.

path.note: Hover at pad-02; wait for return-home-land or go-home-wait

steps.note: Hover at pad-01; wait for next voice command

safety.note: No takeoff unless the triggering slot is ARM ON. Path (move/describe) stays off until executePath or PAD_NAV_EXECUTE_PATH=1. Restart disarms all slots. Voice UI (named pilot) claims and flies so return commands work.
